subject: Operational Resilience Attestation & Deployment Topology (FFIEC Qs)
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@pioneertrust.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurements@pioneertrust.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PioneerTrust FFIEC follow-up: operational resilience details needed

Diego—

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our FFIEC-style operational resilience review, procurement asked us to collect a short attestation and topology documentation for Redwood's hosted and private deployment options. Specifically we need:

- High-level deployment topology diagram (hosted, dedicated, private/VPC, and on-prem).
- Network segmentation matrix and L4/L7 boundaries between customer workloads and platform control plane.
- Evidence or attestation on backup/restore, DR runbooks, RTO/RPO targets for dedicated and private modes.
- Data encryption (in transit, at rest) and KMS/HSM usage details; key custody models.
- Audit log retention windows and sample schema for access logs and admin actions.
- Any SOC2 or third-party audit attestations that map to operational continuity controls.

Can you provide a consolidated packet (PDF/Excel) and an attestation letter that our security/compliance team can ingest? Our deadline for submission to Audit is Oct 22, so earlier in the week would be ideal. If you have a packaged checklist we can review, please send that too.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst
PioneerTrust Bank

We aim to deliver by end of day Oct 21 to give you a day to review. I'll loop in Laura and Markus to pull the artifacts and the attestation draft. Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: Operational Resilience Packet for PioneerTrust (FFIEC)

Jamie—

Attaching the requested package for PioneerTrust's FFIEC-style review. Highlights below and files attached. If you want a short walk-through call we can schedule 30 minutes tomorrow morning.

Summary highlights:
- Deployment topology: Hosted API (multi-AZ, regional routing + automated fallback), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in HA pairs with cross-zone replication of control plane state), Private (VPC option with customer-managed subnets + optional on-prem installer). See deployment-topology-diagram.pdf.
- Network segmentation: admin/control plane isolated on a separate management VPC, customer ingress separated by L7 ingress gateways and per-customer TLS termination. Matrix attached.
- RTO/RPO: For Dedicated, we document target token-serving continuity RTO = 15 minutes (degraded throughput acceptable), RPO = 10 minutes for cache/state; for Hosted we provide multi-regional failover with nominal RTO = 30 minutes. On-prem packaging RTOs are dependent on customer infra; we include recommended runbook excerpts.
- Encryption & KMS: All customer data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. KMS integrations available: customer-managed keys via Cloud KMS or HSM for Private; Hosted offers Redwood-managed KMS with optional CMEK. Key custody models are described in the attestation checklist.
- Audit logs & retention: Default access/admin log retention = 365 days; enterprise plans can opt for 730 days or longer with a retention add-on. Logs include actor, timestamp, resource, action, and outcome fields.
- SOC2 / third-party audits: We provided crosswalk notes in the checklist mapping operational continuity controls to common SOC2 criteria; Caroline Abrams (cc'd) can answer auditor mapping questions.

Attachments (zipped): deployment-topology-diagram.pdf, ffiec-attestation-checklist.xlsx, network-segmentation-matrix.csv

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you want the attestation letter on Redwood letterhead signed by our Head of Security (we can supply within one business day). Also let us know if Pioneer requires a notarized signature or an auditor-signed addendum.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
